annotation.title_clean: Lignes directrices pour une Intelligence Artificielle éthique, inclusive et responsable en Afrique francophone
annotation.title_en: Guidelines for ethical, inclusive and responsible Artificial Intelligence in Francophone Africa
annotation.authors_or_issuer: AUDA-NEPAD; Ministère de la Transition Digitale, des Postes et des Communications Électroniques du Burkina Faso
annotation.summary_en: AUDA-NEPAD web announcement of guidelines for ethical, inclusive and responsible AI in Francophone Africa, developed under Burkina Faso's leadership with Benin, Côte d'Ivoire, Guinea, Mali and Senegal. Covers ethics, data governance, inclusion, capacity building, innovation, and regional cooperation, aligned with Agenda 2063 and the AU AI strategy.
key_provisions_or_claims: Guidelines developed regionally with six Francophone African countries
Grounded in human dignity, inclusion, equity, accountability and cultural diversity
Covers data governance, privacy and digital sovereignty
Aligned with Agenda 2063 and the AU Continental AI Strategy
Calls for active, value-based AI governance rather than passive adoption
